title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Web Terminal Operator 1.15.3 release.
description: CVE-2026-44740 is a denial of service vulnerability in the go-billy library, a Go filesystem abstraction used by Red Hat Web Terminal Operator. The flaw arises from insufficient validation and missing safety mechanisms when processing crafted or malformed input, such as untrusted repository data or filesystem structures. This can cause panics, infinite loops, uncontrolled recursion, or excessive resource consumption, impacting application availability. Red Hat Web Terminal Operator 1.15.3 is the relevant release. Mitigation involves upgrading the go-billy library to version 5.9.0 or later.
